metadata.title: The Great Desert Oasis Expanse
metadata.author: Paul Peter (@asterixh)
metadata.description: A vast 5760x1080 panoramic desert world featuring golden rolling dunes, lush palm oases, crystal mountain springs, nomad traders, and patrolling dune raiders.

item_hero_archer.name: say ["The Great Desert Oasis... Time to explore!"] for (3) secs
inputs: The Great Desert Oasis... Time to explore!

item_oasis_trader_1.name: say ["Welcome, nomad! Fresh water & provisions for 15 coins."] for (3) secs
inputs: Welcome, nomad! Fresh water & provisions for 15 coins.

item_desert_sage.name: say ["Beware the raiders patrolling the eastern dunes beyond the ridge!"] for (3.5) secs
inputs: Beware the raiders patrolling the eastern dunes beyond the ridge!

item_desert_sage.name: say ["May the oasis winds guide your steps."] for (2.5) secs
